notes.title: Version 1.2.4
notes.notes:
- Added input glyphs for Nintendo Switch Pro Controller
- Improved spike ball actor found in the intro area
- Improved lighting quality
- Restored cloud shadows
- Reduced overall size on disk
- Various bug fixes
- Various GPU and CPU optimizations

notes.title: Version 1.2.3
notes.notes:
- Added input glyphs for keyboard and mouse
- Sand shredder animation fixes
- Fish AI fixes
- Improved display mode switching behaviour
- Fixed buggy coin physics interactions
- Various GPU and CPU optimizations

notes.title: Version 1.2.2
notes.notes:
This update fixes the input issues that some players have been experiencing. Thank you for your patience!

- Updated Unity and Input System package versions
- Various bug fixes and optimizations

notes.title: Version 1.2.1
notes.notes:
We're currently investigating an issue that results in gamepad input dropping and the game crashing upon disconnecting the gamepad. 

While we still haven't found a consistent reproduction for the issue, we hope that this update may still help some players. Thanks for your patience as we continue working towards a proper fix!

- Updated Unity and Input System package versions
- Resolved lightmap visual errors
- Fixed a UI animation bug
- Changed render queue of star material
- Improved responsiveness of rail magnetism

notes.title: Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Thanks for playing The Big Catch: Tacklebox! With this update, we've taken our time to address some of the most popular issues and requests.

- Added HD fonts to modern presets
- Added "Modern Half" preset for improved performance at a 50% reduced resolution
- Additional UI polish, bug fixes, and performance improvements

- Improved GPU and CPU performance
- Improved lighting quality

- Fixed bug with fish cash-in
- Fixed bug with post-game reward not persisting in NG+

- Fixed certain sound effects not playing at low volumes
- Fixed visual errors with grapple flower animation

- Tweaked opening area to add gameplay clarity
- Various gameplay tweaks and bug fixes

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Resolved various lingering progression tracking bugs
[*] Added intro cutscene
[*] Added new music tracks
[*] Added new idle animations
[*] Added aspect ratio options
[*] Added SSAA graphics preset
[*] Added completion time and NG+ to save files
[*] Added PlayStation controller button glyphs
[*] Added safety checks to help ensure coins don't clip out of bounds
[*] Added some new tutorial text
[*] Various animation and audio polish
[*] Fixed an issue resulting in desert ambience stacking across multiple sessions
[*] Fixed incorrect lighting for the logo on the title screen
[*] Other assorted optimizations and fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.5
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed major issues resulting in saved progress flags not properly loading 
[*] Walking on sand now produces the correct footstep sounds
[*] Bail's basket no longer shows up on her back when loading a game with the whistle
[*] Respawn fade now appears when loading a game
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed some bugs that resulted in various music errors
[*] The game no longer softlocks when attempting to use a modal while on a tightrope
[*] Fixed terrain shading depth buffer write to properly blend with fog cards
[*] Changed outdated noise functions that previously resulted in static skies and overblown exposure
[*] Fixed some small typos 
[*] Coin tracking should now work properly across multiple sessions
[*] Various smaller fixes and tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Introduced a way to hone in on final remaining collectibles
[*] Added additional input options for toggle/hold tethering, including a unique setting for Sand Shredders
[*] Fixed checkpoint respawn for end-game area
[*] Fixed two medium coins that were mislabeled as small coins, increasing coin count from 688 to 696
[*] Minor aesthetic improvements and gameplay fixes across most levels
[*] Various bug fixes and tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Prevented enemy artwork from vanishing after respawning if their coin is collected 
[*] Allow post-game reward to persist across new sessions
[*] Fixed some misplaced void volumes 
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed progression bugs that resulted in inaccessible fish and coins 
[*] Various bug fixes and tweaks 
[/list]

Thanks for playing during these early and buggy days. Please stay tuned for more updates soon to come!
